race.description: Coutts Tavern Coutts Crossing Cup Mdn Plate (C1)
race.comment: RIGHTEOUS (3) is yet to fill a placing in two runs since resuming from a spell, the latest when seventh over 1400m at Casino. First try at the trip but he strips fitter and can find peak form this time. AYASAKI (1) is yet to fill a placing in two runs since resuming from a spell, the latest when ninth over 1900m at Casino. Has never missed the frame when third-up and will be tough to beat. JUNOSTAR (10) lacks early speed but can play a role late if the pace is genuine. Similar story for MOTION A NATION (11). Watch for hr late.
